name: Mr Bean's Internet
summary: Mackay/Whitsundays dialup + ADSL ISP (Mr Bean's Internet, 1998, Chariot netconnect reseller); ABN matches Chariot Limited; brand later served Chariot netconnect.

events.details: Acquired by Chariot netconnect (Chariot Limited) — homepage replaced by Chariot netconnect.

refs.label: Last capture carrying the Mr Bean's own-brand homepage (28 Jan 2004); Chariot netconnect already named as partner.
By 13 Apr 2004 mrbean.net.au served Chariot netconnect's own homepage, so the Mr Bean's site was gone.
ABR record for Chariot Limited, the entity behind the absorbing brand.

events.details: Named in Chariot's four-ISP acquisition announcement (12 Mar 2003): 'Mr Bean Internet the Mackay market'. Mr Bean's Internet was a Chariot netconnect reseller before being formally acquired (per existing DB summary); ABN matched Chariot Limited.

refs.label: SMH 12 Mar 2003: Mr Bean Internet the Mackay market
